payload.title: Score the frozen arms on paper-600 through reloaded bundles (S5)
payload.description:
## Purpose

Score the frozen arms on paper-600 **through reloaded bundles** (stop S5).

## Scope

F, F-rand, A-c, A-c+F live; 0 / A / D-v1 / A+D-v1 replayed at $0; A-c+F+D as a head-only variant only if its answers are cached (say it is not an independent trajectory). Paired bootstrap intervals for the §5.4 comparisons; no significance claims; nothing tuned on paper-600.

## Cost cap

≈1,200 few-shot + ≈1,200 zero-shot, ≈$1.20; **hard cap 2,400 Jev requests**; cumulative ledger ≤7,500. Pre-approved within these caps.

## Definition of done

All arms scored from reloaded bundles, text-free summaries committed under `studies/results/`, spend reconciled against the ledger. **Stop S5.**

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §5.2, §5.4, §6 step 10.
